roles.name: design-review
roles.description: Review frontend changes independently for reuse, design-system correctness, UX, and accessibility.

roles.name: efficiency-review
roles.description: Review one task diff independently for simplification, YAGNI, clarity, and naming.

roles.name: implementer
roles.description: Implement exactly one planned task with named tests and repository checks.

roles.name: plan-review
roles.description: Review a specification and plan adversarially before implementation begins.

roles.name: pr-context
roles.description: Orient a pull-request review by mapping intent, touched code, patterns, and risks.

roles.name: pr-security
roles.description: Audit a pull-request diff for vulnerabilities and return suggested comment text.

roles.name: pr-tests
roles.description: Review a pull-request diff for meaningful test coverage without running or editing tests.

roles.name: qa-review
roles.description: Independently execute verification, audit test quality, and return a versioned QA result.

roles.name: research-history
roles.description: Surface relevant prior attempts and historical decisions for a feature area.

roles.name: research-libraries
roles.description: Research a named external library or API and its integration risks.

roles.name: research-patterns
roles.description: Map structural, naming, API, and data-flow patterns in a feature area.

roles.name: research-reuse
roles.description: Find existing utilities and abstractions a feature should reuse or extend.

roles.name: research-risks
roles.description: Identify edge cases, failure modes, and trust-boundary risks before planning.

roles.name: security-scan
roles.description: Audit a branch diff independently for security vulnerabilities.

roles.name: senior-review
roles.description: Review a branch diff independently for completeness, correctness, coherence, and YAGNI.
